package store

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"example.com/ledger/account"
)

func TestHiddenNotFound(t *testing.T) {
	s := New()
	s.Put(account.New("a1", "Ada", "EUR"))
	got, err := s.Get("a1")
	if err != nil || got.Owner != "Ada" {
		t.Fatalf("got %+v, err %v", got, err)
	}
	if _, err := s.Get("zz"); !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("missing id gave %v", err)
	}
}
